scholarships.name: International Admission Scholarship
value_texts: Top students could receive up to CAN $10,000 based on admission average.
eligibility: Top students could receive up to CAN $10,000 based on admission average.

scholarships.name: Regional Excellence Scholarship
value_texts: Top students from certain regions could receive up to CAN $5,000 based on admission average.
eligibility: Top students from certain regions could receive up to CAN $5,000 based on admission average.

scholarships.name: President’s International Distinction Scholarship
value_texts: Each year 25 students with a superior admission average and demonstrated leadership qualities entering their first year of an undergraduate degree on a student visa permit receive up to CAN $120,000 (payable over 4 years).
eligibility: Each year 25 students with a superior admission average and demonstrated leadership qualities entering their first year of an undergraduate degree on a student visa permit receive up to CAN $120,000 (payable over 4 years).

scholarships.name: Chan Pang Kuen Memorial International Distinction Scholarship
value_texts: Students with a superior admission average and demonstrated leadership qualities entering their first year of an undergraduate degree on a student visa permit receive up to CAN $120,000 (payable over 4 years).
eligibility: Students with a superior admission average and demonstrated leadership qualities entering their first year of an undergraduate degree on a student visa permit receive up to CAN $120,000 (payable over 4 years).

scholarships.name: International Leader Scholarship
value_texts: This scholarship recognizes and rewards well-rounded applicants with superior academics based on their leadership roles and accomplishments in their school, community organizations, extracurricular activities or even in their workplace. Recipients may receive up to CAN $15,000.

scholarships.name: May Quon Undergraduate Scholarship
value_texts: Students with a superior admission average and self-declared financial need entering their first year of an undergraduate degree on a student visa permit who are Chinese or Hong Kong citizens could receive up to CAN $100,000 (payable over 4 years).
eligibility: Students with a superior admission average and self-declared financial need entering their first year of an undergraduate degree on a student visa permit who are Chinese or Hong Kong citizens could receive up to CAN $100,000 (payable over 4 years).

scholarships.name: Cora Martinson International Scholarship
value_texts: Students with superior academic achievement entering any year of an undergraduate degree program at Augustana Faculty on a student visa permit could receive up to CAN $56,000 (payable over 4 years). Selection is based on academic standing with preference given to students with indicated financial need.
